To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the regions of Poland characterized by a high readiness for cooperation are those with the lowest level of development; (b) in the regions of Poland that exhibit a high readiness for cooperating with others, the level of trust in others is also higher; (c) in the regions characterized by a low readiness to cooperate, the level of aversion to inequality is also low.
the regions in which people are most willing to cooperate with others are also the regions in which economic growth is most likely to be long-term.
social capital is a factor which is conducive to sustainable development, and that it has a higher level in rural areas than in cities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether social capital is a factor of sustainable development.
the relation between the spatial distribution of social capital and the perspectives for long term development of regions within Poland.
the spatial distribution of the social capital in Poland and its possible relation to economic growth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the regions of Poland with a high level of readiness to cooperate and trust are those that are characterized by the highest potential for long-term economic development.
the regions of Poland with the highest levels of social capital are also those that have a higher chance of long-term economic success and are more environmentally sustainable.
the regions of Poland that have the highest level of social capital (from the perspective of cooperation, law-abidingness and trustworthiness) are those with a low level of economic development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social capital, in the sense of a willingness to cooperate, is a factor that favours long-term development.
the regions with high levels of social trust are also the regions where cooperation and law-abidingness are most prevalent.
social capital is a factor which can be used to improve the sustainability of development in Poland.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of social capital in Poland is a process that is still in progress.
the level of cooperation and trust is higher in the rural areas, and the level of trustworthiness is higher in the cities.

, in order to achieve a high level of sustainable development, we should not only focus on economic development, but also on the development of social capital, which is a prerequisite for long-term economic development.
